sub_sector.value: Rigid industrial packaging; recycled paperboard; industrial packaging closures

manufacturing_type.detail: Makes steel, plastic and fibre drums, mills recycled paperboard, and assembles bulk containers with bottles and valves.

production_model.detail: Builds to distributor specifications and supplies standard stock packaging.

product_complexity.detail: Configurable drums and bulk containers feature barrier protection, food-contact options and antistatic options.

production_role.detail: Supplies finished containers, recycled paperboard and packaging closures, and provides container reconditioning and filling services.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves specialty chemicals, paints, food and beverage, agrochemicals, construction, pharmaceuticals and nuclear energy.

notes: Greif announced its coated recycled paperboard exit, with the [mill closure scheduled for year-end](https://investor.greif.com/news-releases/news-release-details/greif-exit-crb-business-close-sweetwater-paperboard-mill).
